body.zh-Hant: 蒙卡達生於1871年。他不是職業軍人，政治生涯是從替格拉納達一家保守派報紙擔任記者開始的。塞拉亞獨裁期間他辦過一份親政府的報紙，但到1906年已與這位獨裁者決裂，逃往宏都拉斯。
body.en: Moncada was born in 1871. He was not a professional military man; he began his political career as a journalist for a Conservative newspaper published in Granada. Under the Zelaya dictatorship he published a pro-government newspaper, but by 1906 he had fallen out with the dictator and fled to Honduras.

heading.zh-Hant: 推翻塞拉亞與轉投自由黨
heading.en: Overthrow of Zelaya and switch to the Liberals

body.zh-Hant: 流亡宏都拉斯期間，蒙卡達擔任該國內政部次長，直到保守派反抗塞拉亞的起事開始。1909年塞拉亞被推翻，他是出力的主要保守派將領之一；1910至1911年在保守派政府任內政部長，後來與保守派決裂，改投自由黨，並於1924年當選參議員。
body.en: In Honduras he served as undersecretary of the interior until the Conservative revolt against Zelaya began. He was one of the principal Conservative generals responsible for Zelaya's overthrow in 1909, and from 1910 to 1911 served as secretary of the interior in the Conservative government. He then fell out with the Conservatives, switched to the Liberal Party, and was elected to the Senate in 1924.

heading.zh-Hant: 內戰、蒂皮塔帕協議與總統任期
heading.en: Civil war, the Tipitapa Agreements and the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1926年蒙卡達支持前自由黨副總統薩卡薩自墨西哥返國，供應武器彈藥，並出任薩卡薩的戰爭部長，對抗阿道夫·迪亞斯領導的保守派政府。他與美方代表史汀生談成1927年的蒂皮塔帕協議，1928年在美國監督的選舉中獲勝，任期為1929至1933年，但桑地諾拒絕放下武器，使其任期黯然失色。1933年1月2日，美國海軍陸戰隊離開尼加拉瓜。
body.en: In 1926 Moncada backed the return from Mexico of former Liberal vice president Juan Bautista Sacasa, supplying arms and ammunition and serving as Sacasa's minister of war against the Conservative government of Adolfo Díaz. He and U.S. representative Henry L. Stimson negotiated the Tipitapa Agreements of 1927, and in 1928 he won the U.S.-supervised presidential election; his presidency ran 1929-1933 but was overshadowed by Sandino, who refused to lay down arms. The U.S. Marines left Nicaragua on 2 January 1933.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與反對民族派政權
heading.en: Origins and opposition to the Nationalist regime

body.zh-Hant: 孔查是波哥大人，1867年4月21日出生，屬保守黨中的傳統派（歷史派）。他批評卡羅（1892–1898）的民族派政權；1900年與歷史派同僚及自由黨人密謀推翻桑克萊門特總統，由馬羅金取而代之，馬羅金執政至1904年。
body.en: Concha, a native of Bogotá, was born on 21 April 1867 and belonged to the traditionalist ("Historical") wing of the Conservative Party. He criticised the Nationalist regime of Miguel Antonio Caro (1892-1898); in 1900 he conspired with fellow Historicals and Liberals to overthrow President Sanclemente, who was replaced by José Manuel Marroquín, head of government until 1904.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭部長與反對雷耶斯
heading.en: Minister of war and opposition to Reyes

body.zh-Hant: 孔查在馬羅金政府中任戰爭部長，1902年被派往華盛頓完成海—埃朗條約的談判。他是反對拉斐爾·雷耶斯威權政權的領導人之一，雷耶斯的五年任期（1904–1909）在哥倫比亞史上稱為「五年統治」。
body.en: Concha served as Marroquín's minister of war, and in 1902 he was sent to Washington to conclude negotiations on the Hay-Herrán Treaty. He was a leader of the struggle against the authoritarian regime of President Rafael Reyes, whose five-year term (1904-1909) is known as El Quinquenio.

body.zh-Hant: 孔查任總統期間（1914–1918）正值第一次世界大戰，哥倫比亞在美國壓力下仍保持中立。他主張行政分權與自由放任經濟，作風超越黨派，常受反對黨自由黨領袖稱讚。卸任後他任參議員、教授，寫作文學評論與刑罰學、憲法學著作，並在阿瓦迪亞·門德斯總統任內出任駐教廷公使，1929年12月8日逝於羅馬。
body.en: Concha's presidency (1914-1918) coincided with World War I, during which Colombia stayed neutral despite U.S. pressure. He favoured administrative decentralization and laissez-faire economics with a non-partisan style, and was often praised by Liberal opposition leaders. After his presidency he sat in the Senate, taught, wrote literary essays and legal treatises on penology and constitutional law, served as minister to the Vatican under President Abadía Méndez, and died in Rome on 8 December 1929.

heading.en: Origins and exile in Central America

body.zh-Hant: 普拉薩1865年4月18日生於馬納比省夏拉波托，父母是哥倫比亞人，18歲起從軍。1883至1884年馬納比省自由派起事失敗後，他逃往中美洲，其後十年在薩爾瓦多、哥斯大黎加與尼加拉瓜擔任各種行政職務，並以自由派革命者的身分贏得國際聲譽。
body.en: Plaza was born on 18 April 1865 in Charapotó, Manabí Province, to Colombian parents, and began a military career at eighteen. After the failed liberal uprising of 1883-1884 in Manabí he escaped to Central America, where over the next decade he held various administrative posts in El Salvador, Costa Rica and Nicaragua and gained an international reputation as a liberal revolutionary.

body.zh-Hant: 普拉薩返回厄瓜多爾，參與1895年8月獲勝的自由派起義，此後歷任1896至1897年制憲議會議員與沿海各省軍事指揮官；1900、1901年國會中，他代表通古拉瓦省任眾議員，並出任眾議院議長。
body.en: Plaza returned to Ecuador to take part in the liberal revolt that triumphed in August 1895. He then served as a member of the constituent assembly of 1896-1897 and as military commander of the coastal provinces, and sat as deputy for Tungurahua Province in the congresses of 1900 and 1901, where he was president of the Chamber of Deputies.

body.zh-Hant: 普拉薩第一個憲政總統任期為1901至1905年。阿爾法羅曾選他為自由黨候選人，後來撤回支持。他在第一任期內鼓勵溫和保守派參與政府，使對手指責他背叛自由主義。1905年他支持利薩多·加西亞出任總統。
body.en: Plaza's first constitutional presidential term ran 1901-1905. Eloy Alfaro had selected him as the Liberal Party candidate but then withdrew his support. During this first administration he encouraged moderate conservatives to take part in government, leading rivals to accuse him of betraying liberalism, and in 1905 he supported Lizardo García for president.

heading.zh-Hant: 財政部長、第二任總統與晚年
heading.en: Finance minister, second term and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1906年阿爾法羅罷黜加西亞時，普拉薩人在國外。他曾在埃斯特拉達的短命政府中任財政部長。1911年12月埃斯特拉達之死引發阿爾法羅派與普拉薩派的鬥爭，阿爾法羅失敗後，普拉薩於1912年當選第二任總統，並在1912至1925年間是國政的仲裁者。他於1932年9月18日去世。
body.en: Plaza was abroad when Alfaro ousted García in 1906. He served as minister of finance in the short-lived government of Emilio Estrada. Estrada's death in December 1911 set off a struggle between the alfarista and plazista factions, and after Alfaro's defeat Plaza was elected to a second presidential term in 1912; between 1912 and 1925 he acted as arbiter of national politics. He died on 18 September 1932.
